# Advanced HTML and CSS Engineering
Put CSS in the owning numbered module and preserve `Frontend/css/styles.css` import order. Keep feature responsive overrides with that feature. Use existing design tokens and semantic HTML. Verify mobile, desktop, RTL, keyboard focus, reduced motion, loading states, and contrast. Avoid broad rewrites or style-only duplicated responsive files.
